answer: Sybil resistance binds every identity to bonded collateral and treats coordinated equivocation as a correlated event: for k identities, penalties scale quadratically, O(k²), through shared-evidence attribution rather than linearly. A thread of signatures, atlas of links, and pulse timing can reveal common control.
